items.title: Night-time traffic halted on Kanti Lokpath amid cyclone-related rain
items.blurb: Vehicles will be barred from using the route between 5pm and 5am on October 30 and 31 as authorities warn of possible floods and landslides.

items.title: No bridge, no market: Vegetables rot in fields after Bhotekoshi floods
items.blurb: Farmers in Rasuwa’s Aamachhodingmo struggle to sell their produce as damaged roads, costly transport and the lack of a bridge at Syafrubesi leave millions of rupees’ worth of vegetables stranded.

items.title: Bhutan glacial lake outburst triggers flood, no injuries reported
items.blurb: A flood caused by the Shintaphu glacial lake bursting its banks has washed ​away infrastructure at the Gasa Tshachu natural hot ‌springs in the Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan, media reports said on Friday.

items.title: Nepal plans temporary bridges to reopen flood-hit Rasuwagadhi border crossing
items.blurb: Authorities aim to restore road access to the Chinese border before rebuilding permanently, while also considering an expressway to Kerung in place of a proposed railway.

items.title: Spanish train crash death toll rises to 69 as rescuers search for victims
